title: The Human Labour of Data Work: Capturing Cultural Diversity through World Wide Dishes

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative design retrospective and collaborative autoethnography examining the community-led creation of a culinary dataset (World Wide Dishes) designed to address cultural flattening, erasure, and underrepresentation in traditional web-scraped ML datasets.

Evaluating the human infrastructure, participatory mediators, and bottom-up data collection processes required to crowdsource granular representation from historically marginalized regions (Majority World) to mitigate long-tailed geographic data distributions.
